| `ra_reg`, `rb_reg` | Logistic Map'in multiplikasyon ara registerlari — `seed_load='0'` oldugu icin hic aktive olmadi |
| `trng_seed*` | TB'de `trng_seed <= (others => '0')` sabit baglanmis |
| `shift_request` | Clock jitter modulu TB'de MMCM yerine stub kullandigindantetiklenmedi |

**Oneri:** `tb_omega_cloak` TB'sine TRNG seed injection senaryosu eklenmeli.

## FSM State Kapsam Analizi (Statik)

### aes256_core.vhd — Ana Sifreleme FSM (17 State)

| State | Kapsanma | Hangi TB |
|-------|----------|----------|
| `IDLE` | ✅ | Her TB basinda |
| `KEY_EXPAND_WAIT` | ✅ | Key load sonrasi |
| `PASS1_ADDRK0` | ✅ | Sifreleme baslangici |
| `PASS1_START_ROUND` | ✅ | 14 round boyunca |
| `PASS1_WAIT_ROUND` | ✅ | rf_done bekleme |
| `PASS1_LATCH_ROUND` | ✅ | Sonuc kayit |
| `PASS1_VERIFY_ROUND` | ✅ | Redundant round |
| `PASS1_WAIT_VERIFY` | ✅ | 2. rf_done bekleme |
| `PASS1_CHECK_ROUND` | ✅ | Karsilastirma (pass path) |
| `PASS2_ADDRK0` | ✅ | Temporal redundancy |
| `PASS2_START_ROUND` | ✅ | Pass2 round |
| `PASS2_WAIT_ROUND` | ✅ | Pass2 bekleme |
| `PASS2_LATCH_ROUND` | ✅ | Pass2 kayit |
| `PASS2_VERIFY_ROUND` | ✅ | Pass2 redundant |
| `PASS2_WAIT_VERIFY` | ✅ | Pass2 verify bekleme |
| `PASS2_CHECK_ROUND` | ✅ | Pass2 karsilastirma |
| `VERIFY` | ✅ | Final dogrulama |

**Kapsam: 17/17 state (%100)** — Tum normal-path state'ler kapsanmis.

### kill_protocol.vhd — Kill FSM (5 State)

| State | Kapsanma | Hangi TB |
|-------|----------|----------|
| `IDLE` | ✅ | Normal calisma |
| `DEBOUNCE` | ✅ | tb_dual_fpga_system |
| `KILL_ACTIVE` | ✅ | tb_aes256_ctr_mode (KILL mid-encrypt) |
| `SCRUB_RAM` | 🟡 | tb_dual_fpga_system (kismi — RAM icerik dogrulanmiyor) |
| `DEAD_LOOP` | ✅ | tb_dual_fpga_system |

**Kapsam: 5/5 state (%100)**, SCRUB_RAM icerigi kismi.

## Eksik Gecis (Missing Transition) Analizi

> [!WARNING]
> Asagidaki state gecisleri mevcut 16 TB'de **hic test edilmemistir.** Bu gecisler hata/saldiri senaryolaridir.

| Modul | Gecis | Tetikleyici | Neden Eksik |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `aes256_core` | `PASS1_CHECK_ROUND → IDLE` | Redundant round mismatch → fault_flag | Fault injection TB yok |
| `aes256_core` | `PASS2_CHECK_ROUND → IDLE` | Pass2 redundant mismatch | Fault injection TB yok |
| `aes256_core` | `VERIFY → IDLE` (fault) | Pass1 vs Pass2 sonuc uyumsuzlugu | Temporal mismatch TB yok |
| `kill_protocol` | `DEBOUNCE → IDLE` | Kisa glitch (< debounce suresi) | Glitch reject senaryosu kismi |
| `comm_protocol` | Tum gecisler | — | **TB yok (5 eksik modulden biri)** |
| `key_loader_spi` | Tum gecisler | — | **TB yok** |
| `spi_cmd_slave` | Tum gecisler | — | **TB yok** |
| `data_gearbox` | Tum gecisler | — | **TB yok** |
| `uart_driver` | Tum gecisler | — | **TB yok** |

## Oneriler

### Oncelik 1: Eksik TB'ler (5 Kritik Modul)

| Modul | Onerilen TB Senaryolari |
|-------|------------------------|
| `comm_protocol.vhd` | Paket gonder/al, MAC dogrulama, frame error, session timeout |
| `key_loader_spi.vhd` | SPI key injection, 3-strike kill, dead-man timer, split-key XOR |
| `data_gearbox.vhd` | 8→128 bit toplama, 128→8 bit dagitma, partial block handling |
| `uart_driver.vhd` | Baud rate dogrulama, framing error, back-to-back transfer |
| `spi_cmd_slave.vhd` | Command parse, status readback, heartbeat, kill trigger |

### Oncelik 2: Fault Injection TB (AES Guvenlik Gecisleri)

AES core'un fault path'lerini test eden ozel bir TB:
- Round counter manipulasyonu → `fault_flag` tetikleme
- Key parity corruption → `fault_detected` cikisi
- Pass1 vs Pass2 mismatch → ciphertext sifirlama (VERIFY → IDLE fault path)
- Shadow counter desync → `counter_invariant` ihlali

### Oncelik 3: Dead Signal Cikarimi

| Dead Signal | Cozum |
|-------------|-------|
| `ra_reg/rb_reg` | `seed_load='1'` senaryosu ekle |
| `trng_seed*` | Non-zero seed injection testi |
| `shift_request` | MMCM stub yerine clock jitter testbench |
